integration_notes: The runtime_programs and runtime_routes arrays are research candidates, not a complete production schema. Preserve established runtime program IDs and their detailed facts when merging.

Before moving mit-eecs-phd-course-6, mit-meche-phd-course-2, mit-math-phd-course-18, or mit-economics-phd-course-14 from mit_phd_doctoral_guarantee to their proposed department route IDs, migrate their existing route-specific requirements, deadlines, fees, funding and source provenance. The current generic route contains those facts; changing only admission_route_id would hide them.

Keep mit-physics-phd-course-8 on its existing mit_physics_phd_admissions route. PhD and ScD options listed on one OGE department page share an application target; do not create separate portals merely for the different award.

The Media Arts and Sciences PhD and the Interdisciplinary PhD in Statistics are internal-only paths. PPSM uses one of five home-department applications and has no standalone application. These options intentionally have no admission_route_id.

CSE standalone and joint PhD options use the CSE application, with a one-choice-per-cycle restriction. The named joint degree fields are separate degree options under this application, not ten separate portals.
